verdict.rationale: Whether customer or transaction data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS commerce platform that handles payment and financial data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training commitment. Related controls such as permissioned financial-data sharing, revocable OCA connections, scoped SPTs and restricted keys govern data access and spending, not model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
